senses.gloss: m. (b. h.) myrtle branch (with three leaves on top), used for the festive wreath on the Feast of Booths (Lev. XXIII, 40).
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 32b:3">Ib. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ שוטה</he> wild myrtle (with one or two leaves on top); a. fr.—Pl. <he>הֲדסִּים</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 3:4">Ib. III, 4</cite> <he>שלשה ה׳</he> three myrtle branches are required for the festive wreath.
<cite ref="Megillah 13a:10">Meg. 13ᵃ</cite> the righteous <he>שנקראו ה׳</he> who are named myrtles (<cite ref="Zechariah 1:8">Zech. I, 8</cite>); a. e.
